methods.name: Stable recurrent BRC zeta / response / robustness calculus
capabilities: exact stable recurrent loop-zeta and symbolic LN surplus
methods.core_law: For stable finite rational W, Z_loop=det((I-W)^-1); explicit branch response is q*S_ba; existing-edge critical factor is 1+1/R; log-coordinate Hessian is delta_ef*R_e+q_e*q_f*S_bc*S_da. After W=A/D, det(DI-A) gives a canonical equal-slack integer certificate and zeta denominator.
methods.hard_boundary: Stable finite non-negative rational total-mass scope only. No signed/amplitude, infinite-state, probability/Fisher, or floating-spectrum primitive claim.

methods.name: Positive-rational BRC prime-valuation holonomy calculus
capabilities: exact finite-support prime valuation coordinates for positive rationals
unique mod-m power-free skeleton and rational thickness
unique rooted spanning-tree rational gauge normal form
methods.core_law: Q_{>0}^x is free abelian on primes; rational vertex gauge acts by primewise integer coboundaries. Every q>0 has unique q=s_m*t^m, and a rooted spanning tree uniquely fixes tree weights to one so non-tree weights are complete fundamental rational holonomies.
methods.hard_boundary: Prime factorization is an exact reference implementation, not a factoring-speedup theorem. Log embedding is derived and need not be a discrete Euclidean lattice. Full rational gauge information may exceed recurrent loop observables.

methods.name: Positive feedback-event condensation and interaction calculus
capabilities: exact event-level feedback condensation against a stable rational background
full updated stability and star through the feedback kernel
conditional feedback kernel after an installed stable module
exact subset zeta factors for small declared event sets
Möbius-primitive directed circuit atoms with rational holonomy
methods.core_law: For stable background star S and inserted events e_r:a_r->b_r of mass delta_r, F_rs=S_bra_s*delta_s. Full update is stable iff F is stable and its new Gamma is Gamma(F). Conditional modules use Schur feedback kernels. Stable declared event sets have exact rational interactions J_T>=1; primitive supports are directed circuits with J_T=1/(1-Q_T).
methods.hard_boundary: Positive total-mass condensation only; subset/Mobius APIs are exponential in event count; no CWM count/provenance preservation, pairwise completeness, unique module credit, signed/amplitude, infinite-state, or runtime-speedup theorem.
